thessalonians1.3.p1.b1.text: So when we could bear it no longer, we were willing to be left on our own in Athens.

thessalonians1.3.p1.b2.text: We sent Timothy, our brother and fellow worker for God in the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith, …

thessalonians1.3.p1.b3.text: so that none of you would be shaken by these trials. For you know that we are destined for this.

thessalonians1.3.p2.b1.text: But just now, Timothy has returned from his visit with the good news about your faith, your love, …

thessalonians1.3.p2.b2.text: For this reason, brothers, in all our distress and persecution, we have been reassured about you, because of your faith.

thessalonians1.3.p2.b3.text: For now we can go on living, as long as you are standing firm in the Lord.

thessalonians1.3.p3.b1.text: … in return for our great joy over you in His presence?

thessalonians1.3.p3.b2.text: How can we adequately thank God for you …

thessalonians1.3.p3.b3.text: Night and day we pray most earnestly …

thessalonians1.3.p3.b4.text: … that we may see you face to face and supply what is lacking from your faith.

thessalonians1.3.p4.b1.text: Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you.

thessalonians1.3.p4.b2.text: And may the Lord cause you to increase and overflow with love for one another and for everyone else, …

thessalonians1.3.p4.b3.text: so that He may establish your hearts in blamelessness and holiness before our God and Father …
